items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: Roosevelt Sykes told me about it, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. He was another great blues man.

There's a Henry Brown that plays blues living in St. Louis now. Can you see him? I don't know. I don't know. I'll tell you how I find out about it. Roosevelt Sykes told me about it, you know. Might be him.
I don't know. Never got to know his father from Atlanta. Well, he died pretty soon. His name was Hemingway, James Hemingway. He played with us a couple of years, but he didn't live alone. He died.
